h1: Do Custom Cups Need a New Mold?
lead: A logo on an existing cup does not automatically require a new product mold. New cup geometry or a changed structural component is a separate development task.
html:
An existing model is a defined starting point

Choose the product reference and its material, capacity and configuration. Develop the logo layout on that shape. Decoration setup and the tooling used to form the actual product are different parts of the manufacturing brief.

A new shape changes the project

For a cup outside the range, send a sketch or reference, intended capacity, material preference and quantity. The development workflow covers design, structure, tooling and a physical sample before production. A visual mockup establishes the proposed appearance; it does not prove that a new structure has already been manufactured.

Compare the scope in the quotation

Separate tooling work, samples, production configuration and packing. Record design versions and the arrangements for tooling in the project agreement. Do not infer tool ownership, exclusivity or a standard tooling fee from the phrase OEM/ODM.
